text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I bet Narita Brian's got this in the bag. But then again, Hishi Amazon did a pretty good job at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're forgetting how amazing Brian was at the Kikuka Sho! She's practically a beast!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Who knows? Imagine if one of the other racers slipped past them both! Man, this Arima Kinen will be one to remember!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone is filled to the brim with excitement for the race that's about to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah! Man, I'm totally pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll keep things short. We've finally made it here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, the curtain rises on the Arima Kinen!
